scope: Developing-agent review of the actual exported definitions and complete compared theorem types; not independent human review.
reviewed_aspects: Exact finite uniform endpoint-one binary model and degree/internal-bit indexing.
Ordinary rational irreducibility, reciprocal polynomials and exact modulo-four companion event.
Uniform fixed-factor coefficients and thresholds preceding the factor and degree.
Signed ordered differences with multiplicities, reflection, finite bounds and real exponential rates.
Fixed periodic coefficients indexed by degree n modulo a positive period, with uniform arbitrary-order error.
Explicit A, B and degree-parity coefficient through n^(-3/2), with O(n^(-2)) remainder.
All inputs in the proved closure are checked; no local-limit or analytic expansion hypothesis is assumed.
Same positive constants in both factorization probabilities; the remainder is ordinarily irreducible in the integer polynomial ring.
Cyclotomic products include repeated factors and the empty product; the finite cutoff is uniform in degree and cutoff.
The strengthened reciprocal event permits cyclotomic factors of the sampled polynomial.
Conditional sampling and concentration use the actual word law and reciprocal-sum fibers.
Exact averaging of selected-bit weights and a coarser absolute prime interval prove the same final estimates.
Phase-retrieval application excluded from the selected scope.
